patthana15.83:1.1: Saraṇaṃ hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo nahīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.83:2.1: Araṇaṃ majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naaraṇo namajjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Araṇaṃ majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasaraṇo namajjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana15.83:3.1: Araṇaṃ paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasaraṇo napaṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
